3 sprigs thyme estimated at 1g per sprig for total 3g (fresh herb leaves/stems); modest amount for seasoning, matches known calories for fresh thyme.
1 large russet potato estimated at 300g (typical large baking potato, raw, peeled/edible portion); consistent with standard weights and known calories for raw potato.
